decision_reasons: Product promise and section content remain inside the governed FTC-backed claim set.
The guide states the important limitation that people-search opt-out reduces exposure but does not erase public records.
Demand/WTP is supported at MEDIUM by paid substitutes and usage proxies without being overstated as revealed individual spend.
Technical package QA passed and the product remains local/unpublished pending Founder action.
problem: manual opt-outs are fragmented across many sites and can be time-consuming to repeat and monitor
promise: a concise repeatable DIY sequence for finding, opting out, and rechecking people-search listings while understanding the limits of removal

rights_flags.detail: FTC source is governed reference-only; verbatim commercial reuse is not authorized.
Incogni/DeleteMe evidence is restricted to market/WTP basis and excluded from product Knowledge Package.

risk_flags.detail: ORG-001 cognition used NONLIVE_ROLE_FIXTURE workers; browser/provider workforce still requires future live preflight.
Guide covers people-search opt-out workflow, not comprehensive identity/privacy remediation.
